name: lighter-ts-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for Lighter Protocol (Rust WASM) - Trade perpetuals with unmatched efficiency and fairness

scripts.build:wasm:direct: cd lighter-rust/signer-wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../../wasm/rust-nodejs && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../../wasm/rust-web
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run verify:wasm
scripts.test: echo "No test suite is included in this release."
scripts.wasm:info:
node -e "console.log('
📦 Lighter WASM Build Information:
'); console.log('Source: lighter-rust/signer-wasm/'); console.log('Build Documentation: lighter-wasm/BUILD.md'); console.log('

Documentation:'); console.log('  lighter-wasm/BUILD.md         - WASM package & usage guide'); console.log('  lighter-rust/signer-wasm/BUILD.md - Rust source & compilation
');"
